LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.addsFundsToThisSmartWallet: Adds funds to this smart wallet.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.allowanceRouteExplanation: This sends funds using the allowance already saved on this wallet.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.allowanceStartingPoint: Open a wallet that lists the connected wallet as a spender.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.allowanceWhenToUse: Use this when the connected wallet has a spending allowance.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.castsTheVoteAndCarriesTheWalletState: Casts the vote and carries the wallet state forward.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.castsTheVoteYouPasteOnACardano: Casts the vote you paste on a Cardano governance proposal, on this wallet's behalf. The wallet's rules and people do not change.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.changesOnlyTheScheduledPaymentsPeopleAnd: Changes only the scheduled payments. People and other wallet settings stay unchanged.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.collectAdaRewardsEarnedFromStaking: Collect ADA rewards earned from staking.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.collectsStakingRewardsWhileKeepingThisWa: Collects staking rewards while keeping this wallet's rules in sync.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.consolidateRouteExplanation: This merges several fund pools into a simpler wallet balance.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.consolidateStartingPoint: Open a wallet, then choose which fund pools should be merged.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.consolidateWhenToUse: Use this when the wallet holds several small fund pools, or one pool sitting at an old address.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.createsOneOrMoreFundPoolsAtThe: Creates one or more fund pools at the wallet address.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.createsTheWalletAndAddsItsFirstFunds: Creates the wallet and adds its first funds.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.createsTheWalletNameOwnersOptionalRecove: Creates the wallet name, owners, optional recovery contacts, and first balance.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.editPeopleRecoveryAndTheProofOfLife: Edit people, recovery, and the proof of life.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.enableStakingReceiptSummary: You are turning on staking for this wallet, so its funds can be delegated to a pool.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.enableStakingRouteExplanation: This turns on staking by setting the wallet's stake address, so its funds can be delegated to a stake pool.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.enableStakingStartingPoint: Open the wallet, then confirm enabling staking.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.enableStakingWhenToUse: Use this once to make a wallet stakeable, before delegating its funds to a pool.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.fundsStayInTheWalletTheyEndUp: Funds stay in the wallet. They end up in fewer pools, so later transactions cost less.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.getTheAddressOrAddMoney: Get the address or add money.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.lockFundsRouteExplanation: This shows the wallet receive address and lets you add funds.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.lockFundsStartingPoint: Start by copying the receive address. Use the form only when you want to add funds from the connected wallet.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.lockFundsWhenToUse: Use this when someone needs to send assets into the wallet, or when you want to add funds yourself.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.manageStreamingPaymentsRouteExplanation: This adds or updates scheduled payments.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.manageStreamingPaymentsStartingPoint: Open a wallet, then add or edit the scheduled payments.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.manageStreamingPaymentsWhenToUse: Use this when you need to add, renew, pause, or edit a scheduled payment.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.mergeSmallFundPoolsIntoOneToSave: Merge small fund pools into one to save on fees.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.mergesTheWalletSFundPoolsOrMoves: Merges the wallet's fund pools, or moves one back to the wallet's main address.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.movesTheProofOfLifeForwardWithinThe: Moves the proof of life forward within the allowed renewal window.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.payoutRouteExplanation: This pays what a scheduled payment owes and records the payment.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.payoutStartingPoint: Open a wallet with scheduled payments, then choose the due payments.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.payoutWhenToUse: Use this when a scheduled payment is due.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.paysWhatOneOrMoreScheduledPaymentsOwe: Pays what one or more scheduled payments owe, from this wallet.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.payWhatAScheduledPaymentOwes: Pay what a scheduled payment owes.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.proofOfLifeReceiptSummary: You are checking in, which pushes the proof of life back. No money moves.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.proofOfLifeRouteExplanation: This refreshes the wallet proof of life.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.proofOfLifeStartingPoint: Open a wallet, then review the new proof of life before confirming.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.proofOfLifeWhenToUse: Use this when someone needs to show the wallet is still in use.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.publishReceiptSummary: You are publishing a governance certificate from this wallet.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.publishRouteExplanation: This publishes an advanced governance certificate.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.publishStartingPoint: Open a wallet, then paste the certificate payload.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.publishWhenToUse: Use this for advanced governance or stake certificate operations that should be authorized by the smart wallet.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.publishesTheCertificateAndCarriesTheWall: Publishes the certificate and carries the wallet state forward.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.recipientsGetPaidAndTheWalletRecordsThe: Recipients get paid and the wallet records the payment.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.recoveryContactRouteExplanation: This sends funds using the recovery-contact rules on this wallet.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.recoveryContactStartingPoint: Open a wallet where the connected wallet is an active recovery contact.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.recoveryContactWhenToUse: Use this when the connected wallet is listed as a recovery contact and the wallet is unlocked.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.refreshesTheWalletProofOfLifeWithoutSend: Refreshes the wallet proof of life without sending funds.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.registerTheWalletForStakingOrGovernance: Register the wallet for staking or governance.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.rewardsAreCollectedAndTheWalletStateIs: Rewards are collected and the wallet state is carried forward without changing everyday rules.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.savesChangesToPeopleRecoveryContactsAppr: Saves changes to people, recovery contacts, approvals, or the proof of life.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.savesTheSchedulePayingWhatItOwesIs: Saves the schedule. Paying what it owes is a separate step.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.sendsFundsUsingTheWalletSRecoveryContact: Sends funds using the wallet's recovery-contact rules.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.sendsFundsWithinOneSpenderSDailyLimit: Sends funds within one spender's daily limit.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.sendsSelectedFundsToARecipientWhileKeepi: Sends selected funds to a recipient while keeping wallet rules unchanged.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.sendsTheCertificateYouPasteToCardanoOn: Sends the certificate you paste to Cardano, on this wallet's behalf. The wallet's rules and people do not change.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.setTheWalletSStakeAddressSoIt: Set the wallet's stake address so it can delegate.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.theRecipientGetsPaidAndTheRemainingAllow: The recipient gets paid and the remaining allowance is updated.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.theRecipientReceivesTheAssetsYouChoosePe: The recipient receives the assets you choose. People, scheduled payments, and the proof of life stay the same.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.theRecoveryContactReceivesFundsUpToThe: The recovery contact receives funds up to the configured limits. The wallet rules stay unchanged.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.theWalletSStakeAddressIsSetExisting: The wallet's stake address is set; existing funds are then moved to the new staking address and can be delegated.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.turnsOnStakingByRecordingTheWalletS: Turns on staking by recording the wallet's own staking script as its stake address.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.updatesWalletSettingsExistingFundsStayIn: Updates wallet settings. Existing funds stay in the wallet unless you choose a send action separately.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.updateStateRouteExplanation: This updates people, the proof of life, and other wallet rules.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.updateStateStartingPoint: Open a wallet, choose the section you want to edit, then review the changes.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.updateStateWhenToUse: Use this when you want to change who can use the wallet or how the wallet is protected.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.useRouteExplanation: This is the normal send flow for this wallet.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.useStartingPoint: Open a wallet, choose Send, then pick the recipient and amount.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.useWhenToUse: Use this for normal payments when you are allowed to send from the wallet.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.voteReceiptSummary: You are casting this wallet's vote on a governance action.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.voteRouteExplanation: This casts an advanced governance vote.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.voteStartingPoint: Open a wallet, then paste the vote payload.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.voteWhenToUse: Use this for advanced governance votes that should be authorized by the smart wallet.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.voteOnACardanoGovernanceProposal: Vote on a Cardano governance proposal.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.mintRouteExplanation: This creates a new smart wallet and prepares it for receiving funds.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.mintStartingPoint: Check the name, owners, and starter funds before continuing.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.mintWhenToUse: Start here when you need a new smart wallet.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.withdrawRouteExplanation: This collects staking rewards for this wallet.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.withdrawStartingPoint: Open the wallet, then enter the staking address and reward amount.
LibUserFlowActionDefinitions.withdrawWhenToUse: Use this when this wallet should claim available staking rewards.

LibUserFlowSetupReadiness.reasonReceiveAddressUnavailable: The wallet receive address is not available yet.
LibUserFlowSetupReadiness.reasonWalletOnMainnet: The connected wallet is on Mainnet. This workspace runs on Preprod.
LibUserFlowSetupReadiness.recoveryRefreshOrChooseAnother: Refresh after receiving funds, or choose another action.
LibUserFlowSetupReadiness.recoveryRunSetupHelper: Go back to the wallet home and run the setup it offers, then try again.
LibUserFlowSetupReadiness.recoveryWaitForCheck: Wait a moment; this check finishes on its own.
LibUserFlowSetupReadiness.switchTheConnectedWalletToPreprod: Switch the connected wallet to Preprod.
LibUserFlowSetupReadiness.theConnectedWalletIsOnPreprod: The connected wallet is on Preprod.
LibUserFlowSetupReadiness.theSharedSetupHelperIsReady: The shared setup helper is ready.
LibUserFlowSetupReadiness.theWalletReceiveAddressIsReady: The wallet receive address is ready.
LibUserFlowSetupReadiness.thisSmartWalletIsOpenAndReady: This smart wallet is open and ready.
